The '''Throne Room Gown''' was one of the items of [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|clothing]] worn by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during [[Gender/Legends|her]] tenure as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]]. Amidala wore the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|regal]] [[Clothing/Legends|gown]] during her [[Coronation of Queen Amidala/Legends|coronation]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], as well as during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Description==
Worn by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo,]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Clothing/Legends|gown]] featured a broad shoulder, intended to make the queen look larger than she truly was. Two panels attached to the shoulder padding featured elaborate golden hand embroidery. The gown also featured large cuffs at the wrist, adorned with the [[Hair/Legends|fur]] of the [[Potolli/Legends|potolli]].  The bottom of the gown, also ringed with potolli fur, was designed to reach the floor and flare out dramatically to hide the feet of the owner. Situated just above the base of the gown were several [[Sein jewel/Legends|sein jewels]], giving the dress a natural illumination.<ref name="CVD" />

Worn with the gown, Amidala sported an elaborate hairstyle, which was, in reality, a wig. This hairstyle was paired with a red and gold faceframe that held the [[Jewel of Zenda/Legends|Jewel of Zenda]] over the forehead. She also wore white face paint with a red [[Scar of remembrance/Legends|scar of remembrance]] on her bottom lip. She also wore white nail polish on her thumbnails, the only sign of culture from her native [[Unidentified Naboo mountain village (Padmé Amidala)/Legends|village]].<ref name="CVD" />

==History==
===Coronation of the Queen===
In [[33 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Padmé Naberrie was elected as the new [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. On the day of [[Coronation of Queen Amidala/Legends|her coronation]], she stood, back facing the large window, in the throne room of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] and was dressed in the elaborate Gown by a team of [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]].<ref name="SWGS5">{{Topps|set=2010 Topps Star Wars Galaxy Series 5|cardname=The New Queen's Fitting|link=https://www.beckett.com/non-sports/2010/star-wars-galaxy-series-5/2-the-new-queens-fitting-7534600}}</ref> After preparations had finished, the new queen read out a speech she had composed the night before with her head adviser, [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]].<ref name="ASD">{{Tales|5|A Summer's Dream}}</ref>

===Blockade of Naboo===
Amidala once again wore the gown<ref name="TPM" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> while in conversation with the [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy of the Trade Federation]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], in an attempt to thwart the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]'s blockade of Naboo.<ref name="TPM" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Throne Room Gown was created for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Designed by [[Iain McCaig]] and realized by [[Trisha Biggar]] and her costume department, the gown was inspired by traditional regal Mongolian dress.<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>
